lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇਈ ਜਨ ਊਤਮ ਜੋ ਭਾਵਹਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤੁਮ ਮਨਾ ॥੧੬॥੧॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak seee jan ootam jo bhaavahi suaamee tum manaa ||16||1||8||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, those humble beings are exalted, who are pleasing to Your Mind, O my Lord and Master. ||16||1||8||
Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:
God is the almighty Giver of all peace and joy.
Be merciful to me, that I may meditate in remembrance on Your Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਦਾਤਾ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਭੇਖਾਰੀ ਜਨੁ ਬਾਂਛੈ ਜਾਚੰਗਨਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: har daataa jee ja(n)t bhekhaaree jan baa(n)chhai jaacha(n)ganaa ||1||
lines.translation: The Lord is the Great Giver; all beings and creatures are beggars; His humble servants yearn to beg from Him. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਗਉ ਜਨ ਧੂਰਿ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਵਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: maagau jan dhoor param gat paavau ||
lines.translation: I beg for the dust of the feet of the humble, that I may be blessed with the supreme status,
and the filth of countless lifetimes may be erased.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੀਰਘ ਰੋਗ ਮਿਟਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਅਉਖਧਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਮਲਿ ਰਾਪੈ ਮੰਗਨਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: deeragh rog mitahi har aukhadh har niramal raapai ma(n)ganaa ||2||
lines.translation: The chronic diseases are cured by the medicine of the Lord's Name; I beg to be imbued with the Immaculate Lord. ||2||
With my ears, I listen to the Pure Praises of my Lord and Master.
With the Support of the One Lord, I have abandoned corruption, sexuality and desire.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਵਿ ਨਿਵਿ ਪਾਇ ਲਗਉ ਦਾਸ ਤੇਰੇ ਕਰਿ ਸੁਕ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਸੰਗਨਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: niv niv paai lagau daas tere kar sukrit naahee sa(n)ganaa ||3||
lines.translation: I humbly bow and fall at the feet of Your slaves; I do not hesitate to do good deeds. ||3||
O Lord, with my tongue I sing Your Glorious Praises.
The sins which I have committed are erased.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮਨੁ ਜੀਵੈ ਪੰਚ ਦੂਤ ਤਜਿ ਤੰਗਨਾ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: simar simar suaamee man jeevai pa(n)ch doot taj ta(n)ganaa ||4||
lines.translation: Meditating, meditating in remembrance on my Lord and Master, my mind lives; I am rid of the five oppressive demons. ||4||
Meditating on Your lotus feet, I have come aboard Your boat.
Joining the Society of the Saints, I cross over the world-ocean.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਰਚਾ ਬੰਦਨ ਹਰਿ ਸਮਤ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਬਾਹੁੜਿ ਜੋਨਿ ਨ ਨੰਗਨਾ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: arachaa ba(n)dan har samat nivaasee baahuR jon na na(n)ganaa ||5||
lines.translation: My flower-offering and worship is to realize that the Lord is dwelling alike in all; I shall not be reincarnated naked again. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਾਸ ਦਾਸਨ ਕੋ ਕਰਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਗੋੁਪਾਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: daas daasan ko kar lehu goupaalaa ||
lines.translation: Please make me the slave of Your slaves, O Lord of the world.
You are the treasure of Grace, merciful to the meek.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਖਾ ਸਹਾਈ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ ਮਿਲੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਹੋਵੀ ਭੰਗਨਾ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: sakhaa sahaaee pooran paramesur mil kade na hovee bha(n)ganaa ||6||
lines.translation: Meet with your companion and helper, the Perfect Transcendent Lord God; you shall never be separated from Him again. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਪਿ ਧਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਆਗੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: man tan arap dharee har aagai ||
lines.translation: I dedicate my mind and body, and place them in offering before the Lord.
Asleep for countless lifetimes, I have awakened.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਸਾ ਸੋਈ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਕੁ ਹਤਿ ਤਿਆਗੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਹੰਤਨਾ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: jis kaa saa soee pratipaalak hat tiaagee haumai ha(n)tanaa ||7||
lines.translation: He, to whom I belong, is my cherisher and nurturer. I have killed and discarded my murderous self-conceit. ||7||
The Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, is pervading the water and the land.
The undeceivable Lord and Master is permeating each and every heart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਰਮ ਭੀਤਿ ਖੋਈ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਏਕੁ ਰਵਿਆ ਸਰਬੰਗਨਾ ॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: bharam bheet khoee gur poorai ek raviaa saraba(n)ganaa ||8||
lines.translation: The Perfect Guru has demolished the wall of doubt, and now I see the One Lord pervading everywhere. ||8||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਤ ਕਤ ਪੇਖਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: jat kat pekhau prabh sukh saagar ||
lines.translation: Wherever I look, there I see God, the ocean of peace.
The Lord's treasure is never exhausted; He is the storehouse of jewels.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਗਹ ਅਗਾਹ ਕਿਛੁ ਮਿਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਸੋ ਬੂਝੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਕਿਰਪੰਗਨਾ ॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: agah agaah kichh mit nahee paaeeai so boojhai jis kirapa(n)ganaa ||9||
lines.translation: He cannot be seized; He is inaccessible, and His limits cannot be found. He is realized when the Lord bestows His Grace. ||9||
My heart is cooled, and my mind and body are calmed and soothed.
The craving for birth and death is quenched.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰੁ ਗਹਿ ਕਾਢਿ ਲੀਏ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪੁਨੈ ਅਮਿਓ ਧਾਰਿ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੰਗਨਾ ॥੧੦॥
lines.transliteration: kar gahi kaadh leee prabh apunai amio dhaar drisata(n)ganaa ||10||
lines.translation: Grasping hold of my hand, He has lifted me up and out; He has blessed me with His Ambrosial Glance of Grace. ||10||
The One and Only Lord is permeating and pervading everywhere.
There is none other than Him at all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਮਧਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਵਿਆ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਬੁਝੀ ਭਰਮੰਗਨਾ ॥੧੧॥
lines.transliteration: aad madh a(n)t prabh raviaa trisan bujhee bharama(n)ganaa ||11||
lines.translation: God permeates the beginning, the middle and the end; He has subdued my desires and doubts. ||11||
The Guru is the Transcendent Lord, the Guru is the Lord of the Universe.
The Guru is the Creator, the Guru is forever forgiving.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਜਪੁ ਜਾਪਿ ਜਪਤ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗਿਆਨ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਸੰਤ ਸੰਗਨਾ ॥੧੨॥
lines.transliteration: gur jap jaap japat phal paaiaa giaan deepak sa(n)t sa(n)ganaa ||12||
lines.translation: Meditating, chanting the Guru's Chant, I have obtained the fruits and rewards; in the Company of the Saints, I have been blessed with the lamp of spiritual wisdom. ||12||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਪੇਖਾ ਸੋ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo pekhaa so sabh kichh suaamee ||
lines.translation: Whatever I see, is my Lord and Master God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਸੁਨਣਾ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਬਾਨੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo sunanaa so prabh kee baanee ||
lines.translation: Whatever I hear, is the Bani of God's Word.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਕੀਨੋ ਸੋ ਤੁਮਹਿ ਕਰਾਇਓ ਸਰਣਿ ਸਹਾਈ ਸੰਤਹ ਤਨਾ ॥੧੩॥
lines.transliteration: jo keeno so tumahi karaaio saran sahaaee sa(n)tah tanaa ||13||
lines.translation: Whatever I do, You make me do; You are the Sanctuary, the help and support of the Saints, Your children. ||13||
The beggar begs, and worships You in adoration.
You are the Purifier of the sinners, O Perfectly Holy Lord God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਦਾਨੁ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਿ ਆਨ ਮੰਗਨ ਨਿਹਕਿੰਚਨਾ ॥੧੪॥
lines.transliteration: eko daan sarab sukh gun nidh aan ma(n)gan nihaki(n)chanaa ||14||
lines.translation: Please bless me with this one gift, O treasure of all bliss and virtue; I do not ask for anything else. ||14||
